close_reason: Moot: DNS-first approach was replaced by cache-first; no _txt suppressor exists in the new code
description: relay_client.rs: the DNS TXT record is bound to _txt with a leading underscore to suppress the unused-variable warning. The suppressor exists because the policy_id is not used (see stoa-w1h8x.3). Once the id-mismatch check is implemented, _txt becomes txt and is consumed. Until then, the suppressor is a silent signal that intentional design is absent. Suggested rewrite: add a comment explaining why the record is not used (or fix stoa-w1h8x.3 and rename the variable).
title: _txt suppressor in enforce_for_delivery obscures the unused DNS result
